title: Xiomara Alfaro and Rafael Benitez
summary: He calls Xiomara Alfaro the linnet and best at Angelitos Negros; she and husband Rafael Benitez once lived in his building.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Maestro speaking of voice, that of Xiomara Alfaro . . .

Oh, I call her the linnet because . . . I’ve heard a song that she has interprets done by many singers but for me I believe until now, it could be that someone else does it better, but so far the song Angelitos Negros, I believe that Xiomara Alfaro, for me, she is number one on that song.
You know I knew you would make mention of that song. I too have have felt touched by that song.
Yes, yes, yes, Angelitos Negros. Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. This and many more but this is one of them. Angelitos Negros.
No, no - now she lives in Tampa. Corporan:Ok.

She lives in Tampa. I received the Christmas card last year. They live in Tampa now. They are always traveling. Always, always. I think they are trying to bring me to Tampa, because I was asked to do them the favor of sending pictures, biography, and if I have a video where I'm performing or something, I think with the idea to take me to perform a concert in Tampa.
Oh yes, yes. Her husband is the Panamanian musical director and arranger
Rafael Benitez. Good musician too. Good musician. Xiomara Alfaro, yes. She lived here in this same building.
Yes. She lived here in this same building. And I think, well, a few floors above. I can not remember exactly now but a few floors above. I'm on the seventh floor and they were a little above.
What year did she live here?

Well, I've lived here thirty years, so I would say they were here at least five years. So it would be, it would be how many? Twenty-five years since they moved. Because I've lived here thirty years in this building.
